parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
- global: Query global configurations.
- rule: Query rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, both global and rule configurations are returned without distinction.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API operation.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.
